title: 第3章  够买50个陆决！
slug: 穿成星际废雌捡漏sss级兽夫赢麻了
content_zh:
这事本来不用她亲力亲为，但她不敢经别人手，怕传出去什么闲话。
尤其传到她大哥耳朵里。
原主目前虽然是个废雌，但父皇很疼爱她，雌母也对她很有耐心，二哥是个皇室另类，混迹娱乐圈常年不着家，一年见不着两回。
只有大哥，姜霆。
严肃的一批。
姜霆比她大十岁，现在是帝国的少将，常年驻扎在边境星域，但偶尔回首都星，对小辈的管教简直严苛到令人发指。
即使原主是雌性也避免不了，怕他怕得要死。
如果让大哥知道她买了一个罪奴，还精心饲养起来，大哥绝对会面无表情地把她关禁闭，饿她两天。
饿肚子？
姜知夏受不了。
上辈子她就是经常加班不吃饭，胃疼得蜷缩在工位上然后猝死的。
这辈子她绝不允许自己挨饿！
于是她以“迫不及待试试新奴隶”为借口，把昏迷的陆决带回自己房间了。
这里的科技发展很发达，伤药都是纳米级修复喷雾，能快速止血，促进细胞再生。
但再先进的科技，也避免不了刺激伤口引起的神经刺痛。
陆决只感觉那阵温柔十分短暂的怜惜了他，突然，一阵剧烈的刺痛炸开！
“呃！”
他猛地睁开眼，本能的伸出手臂挣扎。
“啊！”
他听到一声娇呼。

陆决愣住，然后冷汗直冒。
难道……是自己刚才不小心反抗，伤害到了买他的雌性？
按照这雌性的风评，自己大抵会迎来更可怕的折磨吧？
姜知夏捂着胸口，眼泪都快飚出来了。
这家伙怎么一爪子直接袭胸啊！
这具身体身娇体软的，猛地这么一击打，疼的她两眼发黑。
疼死你小姑奶奶了！
她扭身悄咪咪揉了揉自己的胸。
缓了好一会儿，才直起腰。
一回头，就看到陆决微微睁开的眼睛。
她低头，凑到他眼前：“清醒了吗？”
他表情呆愣。
姜知夏拿起药水晃了晃：“我给你上药，你忍着点，不要动。”
陆决没有说话，目光毫无聚焦，却执着凝视着她。
其实是看不清的。
自从他在奴隶场被暴打磕了脑袋之后，眼睛就一直看不太清。
但他耳朵听清了。
竟然是给他上药？是做梦吗？
他紧绷住身体，生怕自己醒来。
姜知夏看他不动了，生怕他再搞偷袭，快速给他上药。

好不容易处理完，她看向陆决：“能起来吗？能起来就自己去沙发上睡。”
陆决恍惚意识到，自己好像不是在做梦。
罪奴在主人的家里，有一片空地蜷缩就够了，即使是在梦里，他也不敢让雌性主动要求他去睡沙发。
他恍惚地坐起来，想看清自己的主人。
姜知夏指着房间另一侧的沙发：“去吧。”
那沙发很大，足够他睡。
陆决动了动，发现脚底那些细碎的玻璃渣不仅不见了，还被上了药，缠上了绷带。
那是他上一次试图逃跑时，奴隶主为了惩罚他，特意碾进去的。
他嘴里套着止咬器，只能含糊的点头，摸索着朝那个方向爬过去。
“咚！”
他一头磕在了桌腿上。
姜知夏终于感觉到不对劲了。
她凑近陆决，伸手在他眼前晃了晃。
陆决混沌的眼睛动了动。
“你眼睛是不是看不清？”
陆决犹豫的点点头。
奴隶的伤病只会成为被嫌弃的理由。
他屏住呼吸，等待判决。
姜知夏一脸复杂。
没想到，陆决的眼睛会有问题。

原剧情中，女主救人的桥段是被一笔带过的，他的眼睛，很有可能就是被精神力治好的。
可她不行啊！
她没有精神力啊！
姜知夏内心哀嚎：果然，这就是女主和女配的差距吗？
她叹口气，扶着他上了沙发：“好了，就在这儿睡吧。”
陆决僵硬地躺下。
姜知夏给他扔了条薄毯，然后自己钻进被窝里，美美闭眼。
好了，她困了，有啥事睡醒再说。
陆决躺在沙发上，久久不敢动。
没，没了？
没有鞭打，没有辱骂，没有折磨。
这个雌性给他上了药，还让他在沙发上好好休息……到底是梦还是现实？
陆决不知道。
他疲惫的闭上眼睛。
即使明天会面对更残酷的折磨，至少现在，他真的能好好休息了。
姜知夏刚睡着，就被光脑铃声吵醒。
她看都没看就接起来，“喂？”
对面立刻炸起一道清亮的声音：“姜知夏！马上过十二点了！你不是说要亲手送白知遇礼物吗？再不来真赶不上了！我都替你捧场捧到这份上了，你人呢？！”
是姜淮，她二哥。
姜知夏迷迷糊糊坐起来，记忆回笼。

白知遇，是帝国贵族白家一个不受宠的雄性，蹭着原主这位皇室公主的热度和资源，在娱乐圈混成了个还算红的小明星。
原主是他的脑残粉，每年他过生日，都会大包大揽给他操办，送出的礼物昂贵得令人发指。
去年送了一辆限量版星海系列悬浮车，被白知遇嫌弃太招摇了。
于是原主今年痛定思痛，决定送点实在的——她托二哥从其他星域订购了一块天然精神力共鸣水晶，据说对雄性精神力的温养有益处，价值一百万金币。
一百万金币！
够买五十个陆决！
姜知夏瞬间清醒，急着大喊：“二哥！礼物送了吗？！”
姜淮在那头嗤笑一声：“现在知道急了？还有八分钟到十二点整，你快点，水晶我带过来了，就等你了。”
“别送！”她着急，她尖叫，“千万别送！等我！我马上到！”
但对方显然没听见，啪嗒一声挂断了。
姜知夏跳下床，胡乱往身上套了衣服，扭头旋风一样冲出门。
沙发上，陆决茫然无措的坐了起来，眼睛没有焦点地望向她离开的方向。
大厅灯壁辉煌，正中央堆放着精致的礼物，所有人的目光，都若有若无地飘向二楼露台的方向。
露台上，姜淮正倚着栏杆，手里捏着一个小巧的礼盒。
“啊啊啊！是二皇子，他好好看啊！”
“喂，你是雄性！他也是雄性，你至于这么啊啊啊他看我了看我了！”
姜淮百无聊赖的四处乱放电，然后把脑袋缩回来。
呵，要不是自己那个蠢妹妹求着他来给白知遇捧场庆生，他堂堂星际巨星，才不会来这种地方呢。
姜知夏倒好，现在都不见人影！
回头非叫大哥好好收拾她一顿！

“二皇子殿下。”
姜淮扭头，看清是谁，眼中闪过一丝不耐烦。
白知遇不知何时走到他身后。
孔雀族雄性确实有一副好皮相，身材高挑，肤色白皙，微微垂着眼，表情十分温和。
但姜淮没有错过他眼底一闪而过的傲慢。
“二皇子殿下，公主还没来吗？”
白知遇有点没耐心了。
怎么回事，以往姜知夏都是提前入场的，怎么今天……
姜淮也等得不耐烦了，抬手打算把礼盒递过去算了。
送了他就能走人，免得待在这儿还难受。
“等一下——”
content_en:
She didn't have to do this herself, but she didn't dare to let anyone else do it for fear of spreading gossip.
Especially when it reached the ears of her eldest brother.
Although the original owner is currently a useless hen, her father loves her very much and her mother is very patient with her. The second brother is an alternative to the royal family. He lives in the entertainment industry without being home all year round and cannot see her twice a year.
Only the eldest brother, Jiang Ting.
A serious batch.
Jiang Ting was ten years older than her, and was now a major general in the empire. He was stationed in the border star field all year round, but he occasionally returned to the capital star, and his discipline towards his juniors was outrageously harsh.
Even if the original owner is a female, he can't avoid it, and he will be scared to death.
If the eldest brother knew that she had bought a sin slave and raised her carefully, he would definitely lock her up without expression and starve her for two days.
Hungry?
Jiang Zhixia couldn't bear it.
In her previous life, she often worked overtime without eating, curled up at her workstation with stomachache, and died suddenly.
She will never allow herself to go hungry in this life!
So she took the unconscious Lu Jue back to her room with the excuse of "I can't wait to try the new slave".
The technology here is very advanced, and the wound medicine is a nano-scale repair spray, which can quickly stop bleeding and promote cell regeneration.
However, no matter how advanced the technology is, it cannot avoid the nerve tingling caused by irritating the wound.
Lu Jue only felt the tenderness and short-lived pity for him. Suddenly, a sharp sting exploded!
"Ugh!"
He opened his eyes suddenly and instinctively stretched out his arms to struggle.
"Ah!"
He heard a cry.
Lu Jue was stunned, and then broke into a cold sweat.
Could it be... that he accidentally resisted just now and hurt the female who bought him?
According to this female's reputation, he will probably face more terrible torture, right?
Jiang Zhixia clutched her chest and almost burst into tears.
Why did this guy hit his chest directly with his claws?
This body was delicate and soft, and such a sudden blow made her eyes black with pain.
I love your sister-in-law so much!
She turned around and rubbed her breasts.
After a while, he straightened up.
When he turned around, he saw Lu Jue's slightly opened eyes.
She lowered her head and came close to his eyes: "Are you awake?"
His expression was blank.
Jiang Zhixia picked up the potion and shook it: "I'm going to give you the medicine, please be patient and don't move."
Lu Jue said nothing, his eyes were unfocused, but he stared at her persistently.
In fact, it is not clear.
Ever since he was beaten and knocked on the head in a slave farm, he has been unable to see clearly.
But his ears were clear.
Are you actually giving him medicine? Is it a dream?
He tensed his body, afraid that he would wake up.
Seeing that he was motionless, Jiang Zhixia quickly gave him medicine for fear of another sneak attack.
After finally finishing it, she looked at Lu Jue: "Can you get up? If you can, go sleep on the sofa by yourself."
Lu Jue suddenly realized that he didn't seem to be dreaming.
It is enough for the sin slave to have an open space to curl up in his master's house. Even in his dream, he does not dare to let the female ask him to sleep on the sofa.
He sat up in a daze, trying to see his master clearly.
Jiang Zhixia pointed to the sofa on the other side of the room: "Go."
The sofa was big enough for him to sleep on.
Lu Jue moved and found that the tiny pieces of glass on the soles of his feet were not only missing, but had also been covered with medicine and bandages.
That was the last time he tried to escape, the slave owner deliberately ran him into it in order to punish him.
With a bite stopper in his mouth, he could only nod vaguely and groping towards that direction.
"Boom!"
He knocked his head on the table leg.
Jiang Zhixia finally felt something was wrong.
She approached Lu Jue and waved her hand in front of his eyes.
Lu Jue's chaotic eyes moved.
"Are your eyes unable to see clearly?"
Lu Jue nodded hesitantly.
A slave's injuries will only become a reason to be disliked.
He held his breath, awaiting the verdict.
Jiang Zhixia looked complicated.
Unexpectedly, Lu Jue would have problems with his eyes.
In the original plot,The scene where the heroine saves people was briefly mentioned, and his eyes were probably healed by mental power.
But she can’t!
She has no mental power!
Jiang Zhixia wailed in her heart: Sure enough, is this the difference between the heroine and the supporting actress?
She sighed and helped him get on the sofa: "Okay, just sleep here."
Lu Jue lay down stiffly.
Jiang Zhixia threw a thin blanket for him, then got into bed and closed her eyes.
Okay, she's sleepy. If anything happens, we'll talk about it after she wakes up.
Lu Jue lay on the sofa and did not dare to move for a long time.
No, no more?
No whippings, no insults, no torture.
This female gave him medicine and asked him to have a good rest on the sofa... Is it a dream or reality?
Lu Jie doesn't know.
He closed his eyes tiredly.
Even if he will face more cruel torture tomorrow, at least now, he can really have a good rest.
Just as Jiang Zhixia fell asleep, she was woken up by the sound of Guang Nao's ringtone.
She picked it up without looking, "Hello?"
A clear voice immediately burst out from the other side: "Jiang Zhixia! It's almost twelve o'clock! Didn't you say you wanted to personally deliver Bai Zhiyu's gift? If you don't come, you won't be able to catch up! I've even supported you in getting this, where are you?!"
It's Jiang Huai, her second brother.
Jiang Zhixia sat up in a daze, her memory returning.
Bai Zhiyu was an unpopular male from the imperial aristocratic Bai family. He took advantage of the popularity and resources of his original owner, the royal princess, and became a fairly popular star in the entertainment industry.
The original owner was his big fan. Every year on his birthday, he would arrange a lot of things for him, and the gifts he gave were outrageously expensive.
Last year, I was gifted a limited edition Xinghai series hover car, but Bai Zhiyu thought it was too ostentatious.
So the original owner learned from the pain this year and decided to give something real - she asked her second brother to order a piece of natural spiritual resonance crystal from other star fields. It is said to be beneficial to the cultivation of male spiritual power and is worth one million gold coins.
One million gold coins!
Enough to buy fifty Lu Jue!
Jiang Zhixia suddenly woke up and shouted anxiously: "Second brother! Have you given the gift?!"
Jiang Huai sneered at the other end: "Are you in a hurry now? There are still eight minutes until twelve o'clock. Hurry up. I've brought the crystal and I'll be waiting for you."
"Don't give it away!" She was anxious and screamed, "Don't give it away! Wait for me! I'll be there soon!"
But the other party obviously didn't hear it and hung up with a snap.
Jiang Zhixia jumped out of bed, put on clothes haphazardly, turned around and rushed out the door like a whirlwind.
On the sofa, Lu Jue sat up at a loss, looking unfocused in the direction she left.
The hall's wall of lights was brilliant, and exquisite gifts were piled in the center. Everyone's eyes were vaguely drifting towards the second floor terrace.
On the terrace, Jiang Huai was leaning on the railing, holding a small gift box in his hand.
"Ah! It's the second prince. He's so good-looking!"
"Hey, you're a male! He's also a male. Why are you so ah-ah, he's looking at me?"
Jiang Huai was bored and discharged his electricity everywhere, then retracted his head.
Hehe, if his stupid sister hadn't begged him to come to celebrate Bai Zhiyu's birthday, he would not have come to a place like this.
Good thing Jiang Zhixia, no one is around now!
I have to ask my eldest brother to deal with her well later!
"His Royal Highness the Second Prince."
Jiang Huai turned his head and saw who it was, a hint of impatience flashed in his eyes.
Bai Zhiyu walked up behind him at some point.
The male of the Peacock Tribe does have a good appearance. He is tall, fair-skinned, with slightly lowered eyes and a very gentle expression.
But Jiang Huai didn't miss the flash of arrogance in his eyes.
"Your Highness the Second Prince, hasn't the princess come yet?"
Bai Zhiyu was a little impatient.
What's going on? Jiang Zhixia always entered the venue early in the past. Why today...
Jiang Huai was also impatient with waiting, and raised his hand to hand over the gift box.
If you give him away, he can leave, so that he doesn't feel uncomfortable staying here."Wait a moment--"
